name: Camping 101: Enchanting

narrative.details:
Enchanters make everything better and are always welcome at any camp out in the wilds.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Enchanted Lute for your camp. It's so important to find entertainment during your downtime, and this bit of magic can help ensure you are ready to weather all sorts of challenges when you hit the old dusty trail once again.
narrative.objectives: Speak with Jhag in Orgrimmar to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
narrative.offerRewardText: There you have it, you can craft your very own Enchanted Lute. Most folks don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to try it out.No camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those as the basis of your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. Check in with someone who can train you in cooking if you haven't already learned the basics.
